learning_outcomes.text: Learn how to use rapid prototyping techniques, e.g. control algorithms, i.e. algorithm preparation in a higher programming language, automatic translation, e.g. into C language, execution and verification on hardware

syllabus_topics: Automatic generation of codes from text languages (e.g. Matlab ->C)
Automatic generation of codes from graphic languages (e.g. Simulink ->C)
Measuring and control systems with programmable logic
Methods and applications of hardware in the loop
bibliography: Leonimer Flavio de Melo, Jose FernandoMangili Junior and Jose Augusto Coeve Florino (2011). Rapid Prototyping for Mobile Robots Embedded Control Systems, Advanced Applications of Rapid Prototyping Technology in Modern Engineering, (Ed.), InTech, DOI: 10.5772/22030
Greg Rose, Tyler Leman, and Bryant Mairs, IntelinAir, and Xiaofeng Wang (2017). Accelerating Drone Research with a Ready-to-Fly Hexacopter and Flight Control Software
Bill Chou (2016). The Joy of Generating C Code from MATLAB
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
